name: Chimham
bio: Chimham was the son (or close companion) of Barzillai the Gileadite. When David, returning to Jerusalem after Absalom's defeat, asked the elderly Barzillai to come live with him at the palace, Barzillai declined on account of his age and asked David to let Chimham go in his place and receive whatever kindness David wished to show him; David agreed, bringing Chimham across the Jordan with him (2 Samuel 19:37-40).
